reported_results.observation: All tested parent-profile launch, stop, close and switch cases passed.
Baba Is You launched from the child profile.
After child session close, launching Hollow Knight prompted to close the current session, but normal and child hard close both failed; parent hard close was required.

product_decision: A child uses the same session lifecycle as a parent and may close, hard-reset or reuse the current MoonWaker session on the same trusted TV and execution profile regardless of the actor that opened it.
Child restrictions apply only to starting or resuming an unshared game and to play outside the allowed schedule or budget.
Close and reuse remain fenced by TV client, execution profile, transport generation and observed streamer app; delayed effects cannot target another TV, another Windows profile or a newer session.
root_causes: Child normal termination used a separate child-terminal owner path while parent termination used the shared host session termination path.
Child hard reset was restricted to its own exact child session instead of the shared recovery escape hatch.
Replacement and hard-reset recovery required additional same-TV/execution and crash/concurrency fencing to avoid trading the deadlock for a late destructive effect.
correction: Cross-actor full quit and replacement are allowed only on the same TV and execution profile with exact generation and streamer-app correlation.
Enabled children use the scoped global hard-reset escape hatch; disabled, deleted or grant-revoked children may recover only their exact persisted session.

Hard reset stays visible as the active barrier until physical effects finish, rejects a concurrent second reset, terminally releases on success or failure, and resumes the same durable operation after a Gateway restart.
Completed child session UUIDs are durably single-use so a delayed exact reset cannot match a newer child session.
device_retest: REQUIRED_ON_HOST_0.7.108: parent session to child close/reuse, child session close then another child game, child hard close of parent-owned and child-owned sessions, immediate Play during reset, and recovery after a failed close
